rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: A steady drugmaker with strong earnings momentum; it is up 57% over 12 months, only 6% under its high, and its shares move less than most.
rows.risks: Uncertainty over the Keytruda patent cliff and US drug-pricing policy.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: A natural-gas pipeline and processing company whose fees grow with Permian volumes; it rose 12.6% this week and is close to its high.
rows.risks: A slowdown in Permian drilling, or weaker gas prices.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: The leading US steelmaker; tariffs protect it from imports and it has a strong balance sheet. It is up 71% over 12 months and still above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: Steel prices could fall back if industrial demand slows.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: A leading cybersecurity company with strong recurring revenue; it rose 6% this week and is 32% above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: A high valuation that could fall further if software stocks sell off again.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: A refiner that has profited from tight fuel supply and returns a lot of cash to shareholders; it rebounded 10% this week.
rows.risks: Refining margins could normalize after a record year.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: Since its breakup, the slimmer DuPont is being re-rated; the stock is up 17% in a month and above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: Problems from the separation or PFAS legal costs.

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: A cheap generic-drug maker paying down debt; its momentum is strong and it is near its high.
rows.risks: Generic price erosion, or problems at its manufacturing sites.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: A low-cost refiner that returns a lot of cash to shareholders; it rose 9.7% this week.
rows.risks: Fuel demand could weaken or refining margins could shrink.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: A data-storage company exposed to AI demand at a reasonable valuation; results are due soon.
rows.risks: Weak guidance as the hardware selloff continues.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: Network security with high profit margins and a cash-rich balance sheet; after a deep drawdown the valuation is more reasonable.
rows.risks: The firewall upgrade cycle could slow further and keep revenue growth weak.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: Wealth management gives steady fees, and dealmaking is recovering; the stock is up 5.4% this month.
rows.risks: Weaker markets would hurt trading and deal fees.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: A test-and-measurement company benefiting from AI and networking spending; it bounced 9.6% before results expected around November 23.
rows.risks: A disappointing outlook while it trades below its 200-day average.

rows.name: Humana
rows.thesis: Its Medicare Advantage business is recovering after a favorable rate notice; the stock is at a 52-week high with steady momentum.
rows.risks: Medical costs could rise or star ratings could slip.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Q3 beat estimates and the company raised guidance; the 23% pullback looks like profit-taking, and the November 17 Jefferies talk is a near-term catalyst.
rows.risks: China exposure and high volatility could extend the pullback.
